_comment: Which Discord servers the bot reads guild scheduled events from, and how
their events are labelled on the calendar. See the README.
A server needs three things before it can be enabled: the bot invited to
it, its guild id below, and enabled set to true. Nothing here is a secret;
the bot's token is a repository secret and never lives in this file.
FAF Dojo. wlsn offered server-owner access on the issue thread, so the
id and the invite are theirs to fill in. Disabled until then: the bot
skips a guild with no id rather than failing.
The Dojo's 1v1 Night is a recurring scheduled event on that server,
which is exactly what this reads: no announcement parsing, and no
second place to keep the date up to date.
